title: WorkloadGovernor Contract Events
description: JSON Schema for all events emitted by the WorkloadGovernor Soroban smart contract. After decoding from XDR via scValToNative, each event matches one of these definitions.

items.description: Event name symbol (e.g. 'init', 'app_sub')
Primary actor Stellar address (G... format, 56 chars)

data.description: Decoded data payload. Shape depends on event name (see oneOf below).

oneOf.title: init — Contract Initialized
oneOf.description: Emitted by initialize(admin). Topics[0]='init', Topics[1]=admin. Data contains only admin.

items.description: admin — Address of the stored contract administrator

oneOf.title: maint_reg — Maintainer Registered
oneOf.description: Emitted by register_maintainer(admin, maintainer, org_id). Topics[0]='maint_reg', Topics[1]=admin. Data: (maintainer, org_id).

items.description: maintainer — Address being granted maintainer privileges
org_id — Symbol identifying the organization (max 32 chars, alphanumeric + underscore)

oneOf.title: app_sub — Application Submitted
oneOf.description: Emitted by apply_for_issue(contributor, org_id, issue_id). Topics[0]='app_sub', Topics[1]=contributor. Data: (contributor, org_id, issue_id).

items.description: contributor — Address of the applying contributor
org_id — Symbol identifying the organization
issue_id — Numeric identifier of the applied-to issue

oneOf.title: app_wdw — Application Withdrawn
oneOf.description: Emitted by withdraw_application(contributor, org_id, issue_id). Topics[0]='app_wdw', Topics[1]=contributor. Data: (contributor, org_id, issue_id).

items.description: contributor — Address of the contributor who withdrew
org_id — Symbol identifying the organization
issue_id — Numeric identifier of the withdrawn issue

oneOf.title: assigned — Issue Assigned
oneOf.description: Emitted by assign_issue(maintainer, contributor, org_id, issue_id). Topics[0]='assigned', Topics[1]=maintainer. Data: (maintainer, contributor, org_id, issue_id).

items.description: maintainer — Address of the maintainer who created the assignment
contributor — Address of the contributor assigned to the issue
org_id — Symbol identifying the organization
issue_id — Numeric identifier of the assigned issue

oneOf.title: completed — Assignment Completed
oneOf.description: Emitted by complete_assignment(maintainer, contributor, org_id, issue_id). Topics[0]='completed', Topics[1]=maintainer. Data: (maintainer, contributor, org_id, issue_id).

items.description: maintainer — Address of the maintainer who confirmed completion
contributor — Address of the contributor who completed the work
org_id — Symbol identifying the organization
issue_id — Numeric identifier of the completed issue

oneOf.title: revoked — Assignment Revoked
oneOf.description: Emitted by revoke_assignment(maintainer, contributor, org_id, issue_id). Topics[0]='revoked', Topics[1]=maintainer. Data: (maintainer, contributor, org_id, issue_id).

items.description: maintainer — Address of the maintainer who revoked the assignment
contributor — Address of the contributor whose assignment was revoked
org_id — Symbol identifying the organization
issue_id — Numeric identifier of the revoked issue
